##### Project general facts

The Harmony by Wallaya Villas is a premium collection of tropical contemporary pool villas. The project comprises just 37 exclusive residences, offering a low-density, private community set across a thoughtfully planned master development. The villas are available in two main types: elegant 3-bedroom residences (Villa B) and expansive 5-bedroom super villas (Villa A), providing a diverse selection suited for both family living and high-end investment.

Residents enjoy premium shared amenities such as a clubhouse, communal pool, fitness center, landscaped gardens, and 24-hour security with CCTV surveillance. Each villa features a private swimming pool, spacious outdoor terraces, and landscaped gardens, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor living experience. Selected units include premium features such as rooftop spaces, jacuzzi areas, pool bars, and even dedicated leisure zones. The project emphasizes relaxation and well-being, offering residents a serene environment within one of Phuket’s most desirable residential districts.

Interiors are crafted in a refined tropical contemporary style, blending modern architectural lines with warm, natural materials. The villas feature spacious bedrooms, en-suite bathrooms, and high-quality finishes throughout. Functional layouts include fully equipped kitchens, walk-in closets, maid’s rooms in larger villas, and ample storage spaces, ensuring both practicality and comfort. Attention to detail in design and finishing creates an elegant yet inviting atmosphere, ideal for both permanent living and luxury holiday use.

##### Location description and benefits

Pasak, Cherngtalay is one of Phuket’s most sought-after residential enclaves, known for its tranquil atmosphere and growing portfolio of luxury villa developments. Nestled just inland from the island’s west coast, the area offers a perfect balance between privacy and accessibility, making it particularly attractive for families, long-term residents, and investors seeking a premium yet peaceful environment.

The location benefits from close proximity to some of Phuket’s most popular lifestyle destinations, including Bang Tao Beach and the upscale Laguna Phuket resort complex. Residents enjoy easy access to beach clubs, golf courses, international restaurants, and retail hubs such as Boat Avenue and Porto de Phuket. The area is also well-supported by essential infrastructure, including international schools, supermarkets, and healthcare facilities, ensuring everyday convenience.

Pasak, Cherngtalay continues to experience steady growth and development, reinforcing its reputation as a prime investment destination. Its combination of strategic location, strong rental demand, and serene residential setting makes it ideal for both lifestyle buyers and those seeking long-term capital appreciation in Phuket’s luxury real estate market.
